title: A new member, or one back after weeks off, is told their volume is far above their usual week
what: The recovery score compares the last 7 days with the average of the 4 full weeks before this one, and weeks with no workout count as zero. A member who joined last week, or who comes back after three weeks off, gets an average that is a quarter of a normal week. One ordinary workout then reads as 'Volume is 300% above your usual week, keep today sharp but short' and the score drops by 25. The coach is handed the same number.
expected: The usual week is worked out only from weeks the member was training (or the line is left out until there are 4 real weeks), so a first or comeback workout is not called overtraining.
who: members using the coach (switched off today)
how_often: every new member's first weeks and every return after a break
fix_line: Average only the weeks with a workout, or hide the volume note until four real weeks exist

title: The coach's 'best 1-rep max' can be a lighter set that the records list never counts
what: The records list follows the owner's rule that a lighter set doing more reps is never a record. The per-exercise numbers handed to the coach take the highest estimate from any set, so after 100 kg x 5 then 95 kg x 8 the coach is told the best 1-rep max is 120.3 kg while the exercise's records show 116.7 kg. The weight page's own copy of these numbers is written the same way.
expected: The best 1-rep max given to the coach is the same number as the record on the exercise page.
who: members using the coach (switched off today)
how_often: whenever a lighter set with more reps out-estimates the record
fix_line: Take the best 1-rep max from the record rule, not from every set

title: In the gap before a renewal starts, the phone says the gym gives every feature free while the membership card says the plan has not started
what: When a member's plan has ended and the next one starts later, the phone takes the next plan's end date as the unlock date. So during the gap, even past the 7-day grace and even when the gym chose to lock extras after a plan ends, the MettleUp Plus screen says the gym gives every feature free because they are a member there, while the same phone's membership card says the next plan only starts on a later day.
expected: During a gap between plans the phone treats the member as between plans (grace, then the gym's lock choice), or the gym's choice says that a booked renewal keeps extras open; both screens agree.
who: members whose gym books a renewal that starts after a gap (plan switch off today)
fix_line: Unlock from the running plan only, and from the next plan once it starts
